_comment: Source of truth for the What's New page. Human-authored raw notes per release, newest first. The whats-new skill reads this and regenerates the pre-generated per-version overviews baked into index.html. 'version' is the key the app passes in the hash (#version_<version>); it can be an integer build number or a semver string. EXAMPLE DATA — replace with real releases.

highlights: Study arcs on every topic page: a clear order to move through a topic, from the first question to where scripture lands.
Faster chapter reader; chapters open and scroll more smoothly.
Fixes to dark mode and a handful of small rough edges.
Seeded conversations: a gentle prompt to start reflecting when you don't know where to begin.
Bookmark a verse and come back to it later.
